scripts.build:all: npm run build:cloud && npm run build:admin
scripts.admin: npm run build:admin && npm run cf:dev:admin
scripts.cf:local:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/state --config workers/public/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.cf:local:seed: wrangler d1 execute DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/state --file db/seeds/portfolio-seed.sql --config workers/public/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.cf:local:migrate:admin: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/admin/state --config workers/admin/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.cf:local:seed:admin: npm run cf:local:seed:admin:db && npm run cf:local:seed:admin:media
scripts.cf:local:seed:admin:db: wrangler d1 execute DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/admin/state --file db/seeds/portfolio-seed.sql --config workers/admin/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.cf:staging:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config workers/public/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.test: npm run build:all && npm run check && node --test tests/rendered-html.test.mjs tests/contracts.test.mjs tests/workers.test.mjs tests/project-launcher.test.mjs tests/desktop-viewport.test.mjs tests/admin-contracts.test.mjs tests/admin-worker.test.mjs tests/app-isolation.test.mjs tests/quencha-content.test.mjs tests/uniform-content.test.mjs tests/analytics.test.mjs tests/admin-navigation.test.mjs
